topic: Reviewing device data and session anomalies
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on analyzing unusual device data, specifically concerning a vendor that produces low-cost devices. Initial concerns were raised regarding high volumes of sessions (half a million per month) with a significant percentage (78%) flagged as anomalous, often localized to specific locations.

It was discussed whether the analysis correctly filtered for local vs. real location data. Someone suggested checking if the query included an `is_local` check, noting that filtering by vendor ID might be sufficient. The immediate plan was to defer this technical question and instead investigate the packet type, specifically for routers running a 53 firmware version, in about a week.

A ticket needs to be created to track these follow-up actions.
decisions: The current issue regarding location anomalies will be temporarily postponed.
A deeper investigation into packet types (specifically for routers with 53 firmware) will occur next week.
action_items: Create a support ticket for the ongoing analysis.
